verdict.rationale: An official CLI is documented that builds and runs MCP servers locally, deploys the current project to Manufact Cloud, and manages servers, deployments and environment variables from the terminal, which covers the build and push steps. Installing into agents is only documented as dashboard one-click installs or copy-paste config, and authentication is described only as API keys for programmatic access, not as a CLI login flow. Missing for 10: documented CLI authentication command, CLI-driven install into agents/clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI deploy workflow.
